scope: All 45 pinned ast-types, Recast (excluding printer, covered by printer-audit.json), and assertion modules.
methodology: Parse every original bundled module and the ESNext JavaScript obtained by erasing each typed port.

Compare a multiset of original function, method and constructor logical names plus formal parameter names/order. Constructor functions and native constructors share the class name; explicit this parameters are erased.
Class factory IIFEs that only package a named constructor and return it are counted separately.
Compare switch case expressions in order, and every original string, number and regular-expression literal value/count. Static Webpack dependency ID strings are accounted for as local module imports.
This is a completeness audit, not a proof of arbitrary behavioral equivalence. Focused runtime evidence is in ast-recast-runtime-audit.json, assertion-audit.json, and printer-audit.json.

moduleIdReplacement.reason: The original Webpack module ID becomes a static local import at the same load call site.

staticNativeMethodMetadata.reason: Native class methods restored from the original typed class syntax have non-enumerable prototype descriptors and method names, whereas their emitted ES5 function assignments are enumerable and anonymous. The method bodies and calls remain; this static metadata difference is disclosed in README.md.

assertionCorrections: The createErrorType implementation retains its original three formal parameters; an erased overload admits the original ignored extra argument without adding a rest array.
Six self-memoized helper implementations retain their original explicit function-expression names. Their outer reassignable bindings remain live variables.
The original !0 and !1 literal forms remain. The iterator helper retains its raw iterator-result done value, with unknown describing that value.
